admin.title: Hospital System Administrator
permissions: Full access to Network Admin Console (/admin/)
Add, modify, and delete hospital doctors, workers, and auditors
Trigger Emergency Quantum Key Zeroisation and Rotation
Inspect and verify HMAC-SHA256 audit log integrity
Configure hospital network nodes and review link telemetry

clinician.title: Senior Consultant / Doctor
permissions: Review real-time quantum and classical security telemetry (/security-analysis/)
Inspect personal transfer history and decrypted patient outcomes
restrictions: Strictly prohibited from Network Admin Console (/admin/ is hidden and blocked)
Cannot trigger key rotation or modify system configurations

worker.title: Healthcare Staff / Nurse / Lab Technician
permissions: View hospital department transfers and resource movement queues
Access clinical workspace and technical metrics
restrictions: Strictly prohibited from Network Admin Console (/admin/)
Cannot manage staff or rotate keys

auditor.title: Compliance & Cryptographic Auditor
permissions: Inspect and verify HMAC-SHA256 audit log hash chain (/api/audit/verify)
Review quantum key pool sizes, expiry TTLs, and usage metrics (/api/keys)
Inspect active sessions and security policy compliance
restrictions: Zero access to patient clinical health records (PHI/PII)

system_flow: User authenticates with Scrypt credentials and receives a scoped bearer token
Clinician selects synthetic patient records, destination network, and channel parameters
NSL-KDD machine learning classifier analyzes classical network traffic telemetry
BB84 QKD protocol simulates quantum key distribution over Qiskit Aer
Channel noise and optional Eve eavesdropping induce quantum state collapse and bit errors
Cascade error correction fixes bit flips; privacy amplification compresses the secret key
QBER (Quantum Bit Error Rate) is estimated and compared against the 11% abort threshold
Threat-aware adaptive policy calculates dynamic QBER acceptance boundaries
Decision engine evaluates ACCEPT, MONITOR, or REJECT verdict
Zero-Leakage Enforcement: If REJECT/MONITOR, quantum keys are blocked and zero data is sent
If ACCEPT: SHA-256 derives a 256-bit AES key, and AES-256-GCM encrypts the biomedical record
Authorized destination node verifies decryption match and records receipt
Transfer event is assigned dynamic real datetime timestamp and committed to local history
Tamper-evident HMAC-SHA256 hash chain logs the operation with signed log heads
System Administrator governs network nodes, monitors live key pools, and manages workforce

security.description: QBER >= 11% aborts quantum key release due to potential eavesdropping

key_release.ACCEPT: Release derived 256-bit AES key for record encryption and delivery
key_release.MONITOR: Hold transfer in quarantine; zeroise keys and request channel re-negotiation
key_release.REJECT: Zero-Leakage Enforcement: Instantly zeroise key material; abort data transmission completely

record_security.data_type: Synthetic patient biomedical records (EHR, vitals, prescriptions, scans)

encryption.nonce: Cryptographically secure unique 96-bit nonce per transmission

secure_flow: BB84 QKD generates synchronized raw keys
Error correction and privacy amplification produce distilled secret key
Ciphertext and authentication tag are sent to authorized destination node
Destination hospital node decrypts using identical shared quantum key and verifies tag
blocked_flow: Quantum channel anomaly or classical threat detected
Policy evaluates to REJECT or MONITOR
Zero patient bytes leave source hospital memory

audit_and_compliance.standard: ETSI GS QKD 014 & HIPAA Tamper-Evident Logging
properties: Each log entry includes HMAC of previous record (cryptographic tamper-evident chain)
Signed head prevents truncation, reordering, and unauthorized insertions
Mathematical integrity check verifiable on-demand via /api/audit/verify
Logs every login, transfer, key zeroisation, and user management action

noisy_link.description: Optical fiber degradation: higher noise, no active adversary

hostile_network.description: Classical network attack: high threat score triggers adaptive policy tightening
